gaps.title: ProductCommerceSummary is dead code with AI-tell card composition
gaps.evidence: frontend/src/components/product/ProductCommerceSummary.tsx — not imported by ItemDetailScreen. Has surface fill card (backgroundColor: colors.surface, borderRadius: Radius.lg) with 'Purchase confidence' section title — label-everything disease + card-on-canvas.
gaps.competitor_evidence: 2026 PDP best practice: flat canvas with hairline dividers, no nested cards for commerce facts. eBay/Depop use flat disclosure rows.
gaps.impact: Dead code pollutes the component department. If reused, it introduces AI-made card composition.
gaps.fix: Delete ProductCommerceSummary.tsx — ItemDetailScreen already uses CommerceDetailDisclosureRow + ShippingReturnsInfo + CommerceDetailMetricRow which are flat-canvas compliant.

gaps.title: ProductDetailHeader is legacy dead code with circle-container AI tell
gaps.evidence: frontend/src/components/product/ProductDetailHeader.tsx — not imported by ItemDetailScreen. iconBtn style: width:44, height:44, borderRadius: Radius.xxl (circle) — AGENTS.md §4: 'Ordinary Back, search, overflow controls default to transparent 44pt targets' not circle containers.
gaps.competitor_evidence: Instagram/Pinterest/eBay 2026: floating header controls are transparent hit targets with glyph shadows, not grey/overlay circles.
gaps.impact: Dead code. If reused, introduces circle-container AI tell on navigation controls.
gaps.fix: Delete ProductDetailHeader.tsx — ItemDetailScreen uses CommerceDetailHeader + CommerceDetailMediaRail which are spec-compliant.

gaps.title: ProductMediaGallery is legacy dead code with overlay-circle AI tell
gaps.evidence: frontend/src/components/product/ProductMediaGallery.tsx — not imported by ItemDetailScreen. controlBtn: backgroundColor: colors.overlay, borderRadius: Radius.xxl — grey circle containers for back/share/save. topScrim uses glassBg. Violates AGENTS.md §4: 'Separate hit area from visible shape.'
gaps.competitor_evidence: CommerceDetailMediaRail (the active component) correctly uses transparent 44pt hit targets with GlyphShadow only. ProductMediaGallery is the old AI-tell version.
gaps.impact: Dead code, 543 lines of AI-tell patterns that could be accidentally reused.
gaps.fix: Delete ProductMediaGallery.tsx — CommerceMediaStage is the active, spec-compliant replacement.

gaps.title: BundleUpsellRow has card-like container and undersized section title
gaps.evidence: frontend/src/components/product/BundleUpsellRow.tsx lines 138-144: container has marginHorizontal: Space.md, paddingVertical: Space.sm, paddingHorizontal: Space.md, borderTopWidth — creates a nested surface feel. sectionTitle uses TypographyV2.meta.size (11px) which is too small for a section header per Design.md typography rules.
gaps.competitor_evidence: Depop bundle sections use flat canvas with proper section-title typography (17px semibold). eBay 'Buy 2+ save' messaging uses body-strong scale.
gaps.impact: Section reads as a card, not flat canvas. Title is too quiet for its hierarchy level.
gaps.fix: Remove paddingHorizontal/marginHorizontal from container (use parent padding). Upgrade sectionTitle to TypographyV2.bodyStrong. Remove the surface-alt bundleCountBadge — use plain text.

gaps.title: SellerInfoCard 'View Shop' label is verbose duplicate
gaps.evidence: frontend/src/components/product/SellerInfoCard.tsx line 132-134: 'View Shop' text + chevron. The avatar+name already communicate the destination. Per AGENTS.md §4: 'Real apps show less: the object is the label.'
gaps.competitor_evidence: Instagram profile row: just the chevron. Depop seller row: just chevron. eBay: 'Visit store' is quiet text without chevron duplication.
gaps.impact: Label-everything disease — the seller name IS the label for the shop destination.
gaps.fix: Remove 'View Shop' text, keep only the chevron. The accessibility label already says 'View seller's shop'.

gaps.title: ShippingReturnsInfo uses uppercase group labels — AGENTS.md violation
gaps.evidence: frontend/src/components/commerce/detail/ShippingReturnsInfo.tsx lines 212-218: groupLabel style has textTransform: 'uppercase'. AGENTS.md §4: 'Avoid bureaucratic uppercase labels in profile/account forms.' TypographyV2.label role has textTransform: 'uppercase' but Design.md says 'Section headers must be quieter than content.'
gaps.competitor_evidence: eBay/Depop/Vinted 2026: shipping section headers use sentence case, not uppercase. Uppercase is an AI tell for 'premium' that reads as bureaucratic.
gaps.impact: Reads as AI-generated bureaucratic chrome, not authored product surface.
gaps.fix: Remove textTransform: 'uppercase' from groupLabel. Use TypographyV2.bodyStrong for group labels instead of label role.

gaps.title: MoreLikeThisGrid card width constraints cause inconsistent gaps
gaps.evidence: frontend/src/components/product/MoreLikeThisGrid.tsx lines 105-109: moreLikeThisCard uses flex:1, minWidth:'47%', maxWidth:'49%' — percentage-based width with flex can cause uneven spacing depending on content. The gap:Space.sm (8px) is correct but the card width math is imprecise.
gaps.competitor_evidence: Pinterest masonry uses exact column widths computed from screen width. eBay similar-items grid uses fixed 50%-8px gap math.
gaps.impact: Cards may have inconsistent visual rhythm — AI-tell of imprecise composition.
gaps.fix: Use flexBasis: '48%' with flexGrow:0, flexShrink:0 for predictable 2-column grid, or compute width from screenWidth.
gaps.resolution_note: MoreLikeThisGrid.tsx deleted — was dead code duplicated by inline IIFE in ItemDetailScreen

gaps.title: Dead product components polluting the department
gaps.evidence: Multiple components in frontend/src/components/product/ are not imported by ItemDetailScreen: ProductActionBar, ProductDescription, ProductDescriptionSection, SellerTrustCard, TrustFactsSection, ProductAttributeChips, ProductIdentitySummary, ProductFamilyBadge (legacy), AttributeSummaryRow, DiscoveryGrid, CuratedCollectionsRail, PriceInsightStrip, BuyerProtectionStrip, SustainabilityBadge. These are superseded by commerce/detail/ components.
gaps.competitor_evidence: Flagship apps have one canonical component per surface role. Having 14+ dead components is over-scaffolding.
gaps.impact: Code pollution, import confusion, potential for accidentally reintroducing AI-tell patterns.
gaps.fix: Audit each for imports across the codebase. Delete truly dead ones. Keep any still referenced by other screens.
gaps.resolution_note: 26 dead component files deleted, barrel reduced from 29 to 9 exports

gaps.title: Shipping zone three-level label stack — duplicate headings AI tell
gaps.evidence: ItemDetailScreen shipping zone had CommerceDetailSection (label suppressed via continuation) + CommerceDetailDisclosureRow ('Costs, delivery & protection') + ShippingReturnsInfo (hideHeader) — two competing expandable interactions for related information.
gaps.competitor_evidence: Instagram/Pinterest/eBay shipping zones have one clear header and one expandable interaction, not stacked disclosure rows.
gaps.impact: Duplicate-heading AI tell. Users see two competing chevrons for related information.
gaps.fix: Removed section wrapper and disclosure row. Let ShippingReturnsInfo show its own header. Added quiet 'Cost breakdown' text link for the cost sheet.

gaps.title: Trust facts inline IIFE — over-scaffolding in screen body
gaps.evidence: ItemDetailScreen had 80-line inline IIFE for trust facts rows, duplicating logic that should be in a component.
gaps.competitor_evidence: Flagship apps extract repeated patterns into components, not inline IIFEs in screen bodies.
gaps.impact: Code quality — inline IIFE is hard to test, reuse, and maintain.
gaps.fix: Replaced with CommerceDetailTrustFacts component (already existed as untracked file, now wired up).

gaps.title: More-like-this orphaned styles — dead code from IIFE extraction
gaps.evidence: ItemDetailScreen had 7 orphaned moreLikeThis styles and unused AspectRatio import after the IIFE was replaced by CommerceDetailMoreLikeThis component.
gaps.fix: Removed orphaned styles and unused import.

gaps.title: Verbose recommendations unavailable copy — label-everything disease
gaps.evidence: ItemDetailScreen showed 'Recommendations unavailable' / 'Try again later.' error block when recommendations failed to load.
gaps.competitor_evidence: Instagram/Pinterest don't show error messages for missing recommendations — they just don't show them.
gaps.impact: Drawing attention to a non-critical failure. Label-everything disease.
gaps.fix: Removed the recsError block entirely. Recommendations are nice-to-have, not critical.

gaps.title: SeenInLooksRail test/screen mismatch — spec 12 violation
gaps.evidence: Two tests (directDetailFlagshipClosure, nativeVisualAcceptance) assert SeenInLooksRail should be removed per spec 12 ('One high-quality continuation section is better than 3 repetitive rails'). ItemDetailScreen still rendered it.
gaps.competitor_evidence: Instagram/Pinterest consolidate discovery to one continuation section, not multiple repetitive rails.
gaps.impact: Test/screen mismatch. Three discovery rails (BundleUpsell, MoreLikeThis, SeenInLooks) is over-scaffolding.
gaps.fix: Removed SeenInLooksRail from ItemDetailScreen. Updated Design.md to remove Seen in Looks reference.

gaps.title: Swipe-to-dismiss inline worklet — over-scaffolding in screen body
gaps.evidence: ItemDetailScreen had 90-line inline worklet for swipe-to-dismiss gesture, duplicating logic that should be in a hook.
gaps.competitor_evidence: Flagship apps extract gesture logic into hooks, not inline worklets in screen bodies.
gaps.impact: Code quality — inline worklet is hard to test, reuse, and maintain. 7 unused Reanimated/gesture imports after extraction.
gaps.fix: Replaced with useSwipeToDismiss hook (already existed at hooks/useSwipeToDismiss.ts, now wired up). Removed unused imports.
